description: The Federal Reserve cuts its policy rate by 25bp and signals a pause.
Semiconductor shares fall 14% in nine sessions after two of the largest cloud providers trim their 2026 capital spending plans.
The Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to 0.75%; the ten-year government bond yield reaches 2.0%.
A large Hong Kong developer misses a coupon on its offshore perpetual bonds. Hong Kong property shares fall 11% in a week.
primary_transmission: Hong Kong property, real estate securities, perpetual bonds

description: New export controls restrict sales of advanced chip-making equipment to several Asian markets.
One-month HIBOR jumps to 4.6% as banks pull back from property lending; Hong Kong bank shares fall 8%.
Two mid-sized private credit managers restrict redemptions after marking down loans to property and consumer borrowers.
Gold sets a new record as central banks keep buying.
The US Treasury long end sells off on higher deficit projections; the 30-year yield rises 45bp in a month.
primary_transmission: Government bonds, investment grade credit, technology

description: The Federal Reserve holds, and its projections push the next cut into the autumn.
A state-backed funding facility for property developers is announced; Hong Kong property shares rebound 9%.
primary_transmission: Hong Kong property, real estate securities

description: Major oil producers end voluntary output cuts and Brent falls 14% in two weeks.
The Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to 1.0% and the yen strengthens past 136 per dollar.
